notes.title: Scramble Star Crossing demo available!
notes.notes:
In celebration of the release of our game demo, we will be streaming some gameplay on the Steam store page! 

Can you guess which player is human and which one is a CPU?

Try out Scramble Star Crossing today, and wishlist so you can be first to play when it releases! 

Also check out Scramble Star Crossing featured on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/gdocexpo?snr=1_5_9_]GDoC 2023 Steam Collection[/url]!
